function [Ad,Bd,Cd,Dd] = dv_coefficients_BE(dv_test_T)
%dv_coefficients_BE
%    [Ad,Bd,Cd,Dd] = dv_coefficients_BE(dv_test_T)

%    This function was generated by the Symbolic Math Toolbox version 26.1.
%    2026-09-10 22:31:50

t2 = dv_test_T.*4.0;
t3 = dv_test_T.*7.0;
t4 = dv_test_T.^2;
t5 = dv_test_T.*9.0;
t6 = t2+1.0;
t7 = t5+2.0;
t8 = t4.*1.4e+1;
t9 = t3+t8+1.0;
t10 = 1.0./t9;
t11 = dv_test_T.*t10;
t12 = t6.*t10;
Ad = reshape([t12,t11.*-2.0,t11,t10.*(dv_test_T.*3.0+1.0)],[2,2]);
if nargout > 1
    t13 = t7.*t11;
    Bd = reshape([t6.*t11,t4.*t10.*-2.0,t13,-t11.*(dv_test_T-1.0)],[2,2]);
end
if nargout > 2
    Cd = reshape([t12,t10,t11,t10.*(t3+2.0)],[2,2]);
end
if nargout > 3
    Dd = reshape([-t10.*(dv_test_T+2.0./7.0)+1.7e+1./3.5e+1,t11,t13,t10.*(dv_test_T./2.0-1.0./2.0)+2.0./5.0],[2,2]);
end
end
